plainLanguage: Section 125 — Insulting religion. Kifungu hiki ni sehemu ya ulinzi wa worship, religious assemblies, burial places, funeral rites au religious feelings kulingana na statutory wording yake.
meaning: Liability under section 125 depends on the exact prohibited conduct and the intention, knowledge, voluntariness or lawful-authority qualification expressly stated in the provision.
keyPoints: Analyse the exact statutory conduct, not merely the heading.
Prove the required mental element where intention, knowledge, voluntariness or wilfulness is specified.
Respect any lawful-authority qualification and the precise penalty stated by the section.

history.summary: Section 125 appears in Chapter XIV — Offences Relating to Religion and Burials — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text verified against the government-hosted R.E. 2022 Penal Code.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Intention, knowledge, voluntariness or wilfulness should be proved where the statutory text expressly requires it.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The conduct, assembly, place, remains or religious feelings involved must fall within the actual wording of the section.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na evidence zinatimiza kila statutory element ya section 125?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
